meeting_scene:
As Priya began to address the team with a bright smile on her face, Sam nodded in agreement silently, his stress levels lingering beneath their cheerful exterior like an unresolved itch he hadn't yet scratched during this meeting.

Alex stood up straighter than usual as Alex spoke of recent accomplishments and deadlines, mentioning that if only they had more support from management to expedite some projects. The air was tense around them; it would take a breakthrough or two for morale to truly boost their confidence.

Jordan leaned back in his chair with an almost apologetic shrug at the mention of ongoing stress affecting work performance but couldn't help chiming in on how well Riya had handled multiple responsibilities recently, her organizational skills catching Jordan off guard.
